capabilities: Convert a Markdown note into an image board
Add images from the device, vault, or online links
Reorder images by dragging within and between columns
Configure columns, caption bar, asset folder visibility, and language
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; author also makes TidyTasks and Notemoji; supports English, German, Spanish, and French; hides its asset folder from the file explorer.
problem: Obsidian Canvas is not suited to browsing and organizing large collections of images in a masonry layout.

relations.evidence: Create Pinterest-style image boards with both local and online images

summary: Image-board plugin that turns notes into Pinterest-style boards of local and online images with GIF support.
